versions.note: PDF supplied with the assignment; the only arXiv version as of 2026-10-26. Table I: 5 models x 6 settings (Phoenix2014 SD/SI, ArabSign SD/SI, GrSL SI/Unseen-Sent); Table II: ArabSign per-signer SI. All models 40 epochs, LR /5 at 20 and 35.

Venue named in the queue record. Table 1: 7 models (adds Swin-MSTP, SlowFastSign) x 8 settings (adds CSL-Daily Unseen-Sent and a custom CSL-Daily Signer-Indep split); TLP/SEN/SlowFastSign trained 80 epochs (LR steps 30/60), Swin-MSTP 60 epochs; beam width 10. Several shared values are rounded or changed (e.g. SMKD Phoenix SD 22.31->22.1, SEN GrSL SI 8.09->8.0).

status.preference_level_basis: Every model has pinned official code (level 1), but the sibling yu-2025-cvsign attempt on the same CorrNet/VAC code family showed it needs minimal correctness patches on current PyTorch (ctcdecode C++17 build, CTC loss without cuDNN), plus dataset adapters for ArabSign and GrSL; expected level 2, to be confirmed by this paper's own preflight.

datasets.verification: Verified 2026-10-26: multisigner train/dev/test frame folders 5672/540/629 present; SI5 corpus files (train 4376, dev 111, test 180 = Signer05 only) all resolve to existing multisigner frame folders in the matching split, so the SI5 split needs no extra data. check_modal_dataset.sh rwth-phoenix-2014 (SI5 train corpus) passes 2026-11-02. Dev/test corpus labels in this release are already clean (no loc-/cl-/__EMOTION__ tokens; train keeps them), and STMs generated from them by upstream generate_gt_stm equal the repos' official evaluation STMs up to signer-ID case and whitespace (540/540 dev, 629/629 test), so the SI5 references are generated the same way. Upstream csv2dict drops pandas row 2390 of train.corpus.csv, the broken clip 13April_2011_Wednesday_tagesschau_default-14; in train.SI5.corpus.csv that row index is a different, valid clip, so the SI5 lists drop the broken clip by ID instead.

datasets.verification: RGB per-signer archives 01-06.7z on the Volume (import manifest arab-sign/_drive_imports/72178996f6c31e6c/manifest.json). Extracted 2026-11-02 by data.sh -> modal_app.py::extract_arabsign (app ap-3EEqRJGxaxKfMN9NLO8W1O): each archive re-hashed against the import manifest, 9,330 mp4 written to arab-sign/RGB/videos/<signer>/<split>/<sentence>/<stem>.mp4 with per-file sha256 in videos/<signer>.manifest.json, reconciliation in videos/manifest.json. Split lists: the dataset author's per-signer <signer>_{train,test}.csv from ArabSign-EncoderDec.zip (github.com/Hamzah-Luqman/ArabSign @ 8f6e127a054052228027d6da98005f991d300a7b, zip sha256 6980aec2beea93fb2299198f7031991f684bb064c8093343128eb13789318eb0): 9,335 rows; 5 rows have no video in the RGB release, 0 videos lack a row, and every archive train/test folder agrees with its CSV. Effective counts: author train lists 7,489 (7,492 listed), author test lists 1,841 (1,843 listed, the count the ICCVW version states). Labels: the CSVs' last column (sign-language sentence), checked equal to the 'Sign Language Sentence' column of ArabSignGroundTruth.txt for every row at list-generation time. The 709-sample validation subset of the 7,492 training rows is unpublished (gate arabsign-protocol).
deviations: Five videos listed by the author's split CSVs are absent from the RGB release (also found by papers/ben-abderrahmane-2025-temporal-to-spatial): 01/test/0006/01_0006_(16_02_21_19_36_11)_c, 01/test/0044/01_0044_(20_03_21_20_09_50)_c, 01/train/0020/01_0020_(17_03_21_21_36_28)_c, 02/train/0020/02_0020_(02_03_21_21_01_08)_c, 05/train/0042/05_0042_(20_03_21_19_25_26)_c. Signer-Dep test therefore has 1,841 of 1,843 clips and the leave-one-signer-out folds for signers 01, 02 and 05 lose 3, 1 and 1 clips (0.05% of the data overall).

35 file stems carry a signer/sentence prefix that differs from their folder (e.g. 02/test/0007/03_01_0007_(16_02_21_21_01_01)_c.mp4); the folder path, which the author's CSVs list, defines signer, split and sentence, and sample IDs are <signer>_<sentence>_<timestamp> from the path.

datasets.verification: Populated 2026-11-02 by data.sh -> modal_app.py::populate_gsl (app ap-Sg1meM9jpuHIbOLcF5I5bd) at /datasets/gsl-continuous: the 15 RGB zips (health1-5, kep1-5, police1-5) and supplementary.zip of Zenodo record 3941811 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3941811, license cc-by-4.0), 40.17 GB, each verified against Zenodo's md5 with sha256 recorded in gsl-continuous/manifest.json; depth zips not needed and not fetched. Split files fetched from the dataset's public Drive folder 18ruYi9MULMm1KQtUgdIhN0m-XilRhncg into gsl-continuous/splits/ and verified against the sha256 recorded on 2026-10-26. Row format '<scenario>_signer<k>_rep<r>_sentences/sentences<NNNN>|GLOSS ...'; zip entries '<that folder>/frame_<i>.jpg'. 'GSL SI' gsl_split_SI_{train,dev,test}.csv = 8821/588/881 rows (train signers 1,2,4,5,6,7; dev/test signer 3) = paper's Signer-Indep; 'GSL SD' gsl_{train,dev,test}_unseen.txt = 8189/1063/1043 rows, 0 of 1043 test sentences occur in train (45 unique test sentences) = paper's Unseen-Sent. check_modal_dataset.sh gsl-continuous manifest.json passes.
deviations: The SI dev/test files lack a trailing newline, so 'wc -l' reports 587/880 lines for the 588/881 entries Zenodo states; all entries are used.

metric_definitions.name: Word error rate (gloss level)
metric_definitions.implementation: Each pinned upstream repo's evaluation: NIST SCTK sclite over CTM hypotheses vs STM references (evaluation/slr_eval), as selected by evaluate_tool: sclite in configs/baseline.yaml
metric_definitions.version: SCTK commit to be pinned in the Dockerfile (yu-2025-cvsign uses 9688a26882a688132a5e414cadcb4c19b6fffaba)
metric_definitions.aggregation: corpus-level (S+D+I)/N over the split (paper Eq. 1); ArabSign Signer-Indep = arithmetic mean of 6 per-fold WERs (Table II)

ICCVW 2025 p.5 Table 1: 7 models x 8 columns = 56 WERs; Section 3.3 gives 80-epoch schedules for TLP/SEN/SlowFastSign
Queue record: pdf_url=arxiv abs 2406.12369, venue=ICCVW 2025, year=2024, datasets list excludes CSL-Daily

alternatives.decision_needed: Confirm the supplied arXiv v1 PDF defines the target.

gates.reason: The paper's stated shared protocol conflicts with every pinned upstream config, and the choice changes training behavior.
evidence: arXiv v1 Sec. IV 'Experiments Setup': 'We followed the same experimental settings described in each study' AND 'Adam ... 40 epochs ... batch size of 2 and an initial learning rate of 10^-3, reduced at epochs 20 and 35 by a factor of five'
VAC_CSLR@71f3e03, CorrNet@a812814, TLP@21be215, SEN@c9a4c7e configs/baseline.yaml: base_lr 0.0001
TLP and SEN upstream: num_epoch 80, step [40, 60]; ICCVW 2025 version Sec. 3.3 later states TLP/SEN were trained 80 epochs (steps 30, 60), still with lr 1e-3

ICCVW 2025 PDF (sha256 922a2038...) Sec. 3.3: 'The VAC, SMKD, and CorrNet models were trained for 40 epochs ... The models TLP, SEN, and SlowFastSign were trained for 80 epochs, following the training protocols outlined by their respective authors' and, for TLP/SEN/SlowFastSign, 'the learning rate was adjusted at epochs 30 and 60'; lr 1e-3 and batch 2 for all.

Shared Table I cells, arXiv v1 vs ICCVW Table 1 (checked 2026-11-02 from both PDFs): all six TLP values and five of six SEN values are identical at one decimal; SEN GrSL Signer-Indep is 8.09 in v1, 8.0 in ICCVW Table 1 and 8.1 in ICCVW Fig. 3. Across all 30 shared cells, 26 are identical at one decimal, 3 match only by truncation (SMKD Phoenix SI 43.08->43.0, SEN GrSL SI 8.09->8.0, CorrNet ArabSign SI 7.65->7.6), and 1 differs (SMKD Phoenix SD 22.31->22.1). So the TLP/SEN numbers did not change although the stated schedule changed from 40 to 80 epochs; the evidence does not show which schedule produced them.
gates.required_action: Choose learning rate (paper 1e-3 vs upstream 1e-4) and TLP/SEN schedule (v1-stated 40 epochs/steps 20,35 vs upstream 80/steps 40,60) before any full run.

resolution.decision: Use the arXiv v1 stated protocol for every model: Adam, base_lr 0.001, 40 epochs, lr x0.2 at epochs 20 and 35, batch 2. Each model otherwise runs its pinned upstream config unchanged (loss weights, augmentation, decoding).
resolution.basis: Operator decision at the protocol gate after reviewing the paper text and the pinned upstream configs.
resolution.follow_up: 2026-11-02: decision kept (arXiv v1 is the assigned paper; its text states 40 epochs, steps 20/35 for all five models). The ICCVW 80-epoch (steps 30/60) statement for TLP/SEN is recorded as evidence and as a README deviation note. Before the full TLP and SEN runs launch, the measured cost of training them for 80 epochs, and whether it fits under the USD 2,000 ceiling, is reported to the operator for a decision.

gates.reason: Table I needs about 55 single-GPU trainings (Phoenix SD 5, Phoenix SI 5, ArabSign SD 5, ArabSign leave-one-signer-out 30, GrSL SI 5, GrSL Unseen-Sent 5); the projection far exceeds the 24 GPU-hour autonomous gate.
evidence: Paper ICCVW Sec. 4: ~10 h per 40-epoch VAC/SMKD/CorrNet run on Phoenix2014/GrSL on one RTX A6000; ArabSign about half
papers/yu-2025-cvsign run full-phoenix14t-002: CorrNet-family model on PHOENIX14-T, one L40S, ~33 min/epoch incl. dev eval (heavier ResNet34 variant, 7096 train clips vs 5672 here)

Pre-preflight projection presented in #repro-sign-team-r on 2026-10-30 (40 epochs for all models): about 420-610 L40S GPU-hours including about 15 GPU-hours of preflights and a 10% retry margin, i.e. about USD 1,350-2,000 at USD 3.22/h effective (L40S with 16 CPU cores and 64 GiB, as measured in papers/yu-2025-cvsign); the 30 ArabSign leave-one-signer-out runs account for about USD 550-1,050. This supersedes the earlier GPU-only figure of USD 800-1,600, which omitted CPU/memory charges, preflights and retries.
gates.required_action: None outstanding. Launch blocks in the order Phoenix SD, Phoenix SI, GrSL SI, GrSL Unseen-Sent, ArabSign SD, ArabSign LOSO, each with declared ceilings and cumulative spend tracked against USD 2,000; ArabSign blocks wait for their protocol gates.

resolution.decision: Approved: the full arXiv v1 Table I, including the 30 ArabSign leave-one-signer-out runs.
resolution.basis: Project lead's approval in #repro-sign-team-r on 2026-11-02, relayed by the operator, after the 420-610 GPU-hour / USD 1,350-2,000 estimate.

ceilings.note: USD 2,000 is an absolute ceiling for this reproduction (preflights, full runs, evaluation and retries together). Cumulative spend is tracked per block against it; the GPU-hour figure is the ceiling divided by the L40S rate.
